source: Seven learning exchanges saved as one batch
lessonTheme: Readiness recall, pero contrasts and practical requests
summary: Correctly retried feminine not-yet readiness and used lista in four readiness contexts. Introduced pero and correctly used it twice. Recalled Necesitamos revisarla porque es importante without a form hint. Corrected Podes revisar esta to ¿Puedes revisar esto?; immediately repeated the corrected review request, while the tutor had asked a different test-this-function target. No successful independent esta función production recorded.

observations.learnerText: La funcion todavia No esta lista
observations.correctedText: La función todavía no está lista.
observations.outcome: Correct retry after several intervening exchanges: time meaning, verb, feminine agreement and negation all correct. Accents/capitalization supplied. Same-day recall only.
Correct reason sentence with feminine la/lista for stated función referent; está accent supplied. Tutor then introduced pero = but.

observations.learnerText: Queremos usarla pero todavia No esta lista
observations.correctedText: Queremos usarla, pero todavía no está lista.
observations.outcome: Correct first use of pero after its translation, retaining feminine object and readiness agreement. Standard spelling/punctuation supplied.

observations.learnerText: Esta lista, Pero No queremos publicarla
observations.correctedText: Está lista, pero no queremos publicarla.
observations.outcome: Correct contrast, negation and feminine publicarla/lista with unstated subject. Capitalization and está accent supplied.
Correct necesitamos + revisarla, feminine object and es importante without a form hint. Prior reviser error did not recur.
For the practised tú request, podes corrected to puedes. Standalone this corrected from esta to esto; tutor modelled esta función for this function. No general regional conjugation lesson given.

Correct immediate repeat of the review-this request after the model, with opening ¿ supplied. The intervening tutor prompt asked Can you test this function?; the learner's grammatical sentence instead means Can you review this? Tutor acknowledged that meaning and reminded probar for test. Do not count as a successful test-this-function attempt.

nextSteps: Recheck puedes and esto after intervening material
Contrast revisar and probar while accepting grammatical responses with different meanings
Revisit esta función separately from standalone esto
Review location with estar, then earlier goals and permission phrases
assessmentNote: Successful same-day recall and immediate repetitions are recorded separately. Four correct feminine readiness uses follow a prior agreement error but do not establish long-term retention. No blanket rule against regional poder forms is inferred.
